title: Pure The Weather
summary: The Weather cards only, with generic Rank 3s, Links and staples. The Weather Painters are Level 3 Fairies that place Canvas Spells/Traps face-up from the Deck. Each Canvas gives the Painters in its column and the adjacent columns a Quick Effect that banishes the Painter itself. The Painter comes back in the next Standby Phase, ready to use the effect again. The Snowy Canvas searches, the Rainy Canvas bounces a Spell/Trap, and the Sunny Canvas swaps one Painter for another. The Weather Painter Snow places a Canvas on Normal Summon, and Thunder sends one to place another. The 2022 cards lead. The Weather Forecast places a Canvas from the Deck and lets face-up Canvases count as Link material. The Weather Painter Moonbow revives a banished Painter and calls The Weather Painter Rainbow, which negates a Special Summon.
